name: parallel-search
description: Search the web and fetch page content with Parallel's hosted MCP server. No account or API key is required for anonymous, rate-limited search and fetch.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP server. Explicitly choose it with mcpm install parallel-search, then connect your MCP client using mcpm run parallel-search. Anonymous search and fetch are rate limited; authenticated research is outside this setup.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information and return source URLs with excerpts.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch content from specific web page URLs.

examples.title: Find and read documentation
examples.description: Search for official documentation, then fetch a relevant source page.
examples.prompt: Find the official Python documentation for asyncio TaskGroup and read the relevant page.
